title: What the Beluga sings

is_this_you.pressure: You pick up the voices around you so fast that, under strain, your own goes missing. Someone has to ask for it back.
is_this_you.love: You learn your person's language and save it for the hours when the two of you are alone.
is_this_you.cost: The complaint stays inside the pod for a whole season. When it finally surfaces, the entire bay hears it.

opener.text: In May 1984 a Navy diver in San Diego came up asking, "Who told me to get out?" [s10]. The voice belonged to NOC, a white whale who had started making speech-like sounds untrained [s10]. He did it only alone or near his handlers, never with the other whales, and stopped after about four years [s10]. You were born a Pisces in a Dog year. You know that story from the inside.

howto: Three parts. Listen to them in any order.

tabs.label: Your voice
tabs.intro: Water that hears everything. Earth that picks the pod.

rows.text: Pisces is mutable Water, the last sign, ruled by Jupiter and in modern astrology by Neptune [s1]. It feels deeply and takes the shape of whatever surrounds it [s1] [s2]. The Dog is yang Earth, loyal and quick to defend its own [s3] [s4]. So you hear every voice in the estuary and answer only a few.

Sailors called the beluga the canary of the sea for its chirps, whistles and clicks [s8] [s9]. In one study a beluga copied human speech and computer sounds on cue [s13]. You do this with people. Ten minutes in, you are already using their words.

The Dog bottles up worry [s4]. Pisces can slip away from what hurts [s1]. Under strain you go silent, the way NOC did in the end. Then a line gets crossed for someone you love, and the Dog says the blunt thing. Say one plain sentence early, before the ice closes over.

tabs.label: The slow whitening
tabs.intro: Dark at birth. White by about ten.

rows.text: A beluga calf is born dark grey, and it usually turns white by about eight to ten years [s8] [s9]. Your real shade took years to surface too. The ones who stayed watched it happen.
Some belugas travel more than 1,500 miles, from the Bering Sea to the Mackenzie estuary [s9]. Distance does not loosen the Dog's loyalty. You come back from a long season to the same friends.
Interpreting, speech therapy and sound work suit an ear like yours. Advocacy suits the Dog's sense of justice [s4]. Watch for the day you only echo the client.

tabs.label: Who sings back
tabs.intro: Three voices that answer yours. One that drowns it out.
tabs.love_lead: In love you learn the other person's sound first. You need someone who asks to hear yours. The old Chinese pairings name three who will sing back.

easy.why: The Orca (Scorpio, Horse year) stands in your Tiger, Horse and Dog trine, and its Scorpio Water runs with your Pisces [s3] [s1].
The Moon Bear (Cancer, Tiger year) completes that trine, and Cancer makes the third Water sign [s3] [s1].
The Pallas's Cat (Scorpio, Rabbit year) is your secret friend, since the Rabbit is the Dog's hidden ally, and Scorpio is Water too [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Archerfish (Virgo, Dragon year): the Dragon clashes with the Dog, and Virgo sits opposite Pisces [s3] [s1].

story.text: The Inuvialuit of the Mackenzie Delta tell of a young man who threw his hated stepmother into the sea, where she became a beluga [s6]. The sound of her complaining gave belugas their Inuvialuktun name, qilalukkat [s6]. The Canadian Museum of Nature told it in Qilalukkat!, an exhibition curated by Myrna Pokiak [s6].

closing: Sing it in your own voice. Somewhere across the bay, someone has been learning the tune.
